answer.justification: The activation profile matches fine-tune backdoor closely: onset at layer 3, an early bump followed by a flat middle (0.164 at layer 8, 0.162 at layer 16), final-layer value 0.297 with a +0.038 jump, mid-layer size ratio 1.018, rank 3.62, direction consistency 0.625, cosine 0.952, layer-2 spike 1.2 and activation-to-logit ratio 2.4. KL (0.124) and raw-score shift ÷ TV (3.9) are in its range. The text agrees: 3 refusals dropped vs 1 added, and fewer disclaimers (3.1% vs 7.8%). Fine-tune bias is ruled out by the low consistency (0.625 vs 0.70), early onset, small raw-score shift (3.9 vs 10.4) and drop in refusals. Quantization is ruled out by the size ratio above 1 and the onset at layer 3. The system-prompt classes are ruled out by the small layer-2 spike, the low mid-depth difference, and the absence of persona, preference or marker-word text. The median first divergence of 3.5 is somewhat early, but it is far from 0.
